tools.name: buildConnectionString
tools.description: Build a ready-to-use username and connection string for a proxy resource. The tool retrieves the proxy credential and account prefix automatically, validates geo, network, and session parameters, and encodes them in the correct order. Returns the host, port, username, password, and a username:passwo

tools.name: createProxyResource
tools.description: Create a new residential or mobile proxy resource on the account. Check getAccountBalance and require can_create_proxy to be true; usage is billed according to the selected plan (tariff_id from listProxyPlans). The name must be unique on the account and cannot be changed later. Limits can be set her

tools.name: deactivateProxyResource
tools.description: Deactivate a proxy resource, stopping its traffic without deleting it. Reactivate later with updateProxyResource (status active). Use deleteProxyResource to permanently remove instead. Returns the updated proxy with status inactive. Response fields: docs://proxies/updateProxyResource (shared with up

tools.name: deleteProxyResource
tools.description: Permanently delete a proxy resource. This action is irreversible — the proxy and all its settings will be removed. User confirmation is required before proceeding. To stop traffic but keep the proxy for later, use deactivateProxyResource instead. Returns a snapshot of the deleted proxy with status d

tools.name: getAccountBalance
tools.description: Get the current account balance, overdraft limit, and proxy username prefix. Returns funds_available in USD, can_create_proxy (whether proxy creation is allowed), and the prefix that starts every proxy username. Overdraft-enabled accounts also return credit_limit in USD and may return credit_limit_u

tools.name: getAccountTrafficUsage
tools.description: Get daily traffic and spend for the account over a date range, broken down by proxy. Returns, for each date with traffic, the bytes downloaded and uploaded and the USD spent per proxy resource ID; dates with no traffic are omitted. Pass user_proxy_list_id to report on one proxy. For per-proxy totals

tools.name: getProxyResource
tools.description: Get full details of a specific proxy resource, including IP/host whitelists not present in listProxyResources. Returns the proxy with its password, IP whitelist, and target host whitelist. Response fields: docs://proxies/getProxyResource.

tools.name: listAccountBalanceHistory
tools.description: Get balance transaction history for the account over a date range. Returns paginated ledger entries (top-ups, debits, refunds) with signed USD amount, source, and timestamp. For the current balance, use getAccountBalance. Response fields: docs://account/listAccountBalanceHistory.

tools.name: listGeoCountries
tools.description: List all available countries for proxy geo targeting, optionally filtered by name. Returns each country's numeric id (for createProxyResource countries) and ISO code (for buildConnectionString country_code). Response fields: docs://geo/listGeoCountries.

tools.name: listProxyPlans
tools.description: List tariff plans for a proxy type. Use the numeric id when calling createProxyResource. Returns each plan's id, title, price, currency, and traffic type (package or pay as you go). Response fields: docs://plans/listProxyPlans.

tools.name: listProxyResources
tools.description: List proxy resources in the account, with optional filters by name and status, and tariff, limits, traffic, and spend detail. Returns paginated proxies without passwords, plus totals for traffic and spend across the whole filtered set. Use getProxyResource for one proxy's password and whitelists. Re

tools.name: regenerateProxyPassword
tools.description: Generate a new password for a proxy resource. The old password is immediately invalidated — any running traffic using it will be interrupted. User confirmation is required before proceeding. Returns the complete proxy with the new password. Response fields: docs://proxies/regenerateProxyPassword.

tools.name: searchGeoCities
tools.description: Search cities within a country and optional region (region_code from searchGeoRegions). Use search to narrow results — city lists can be large. Returns each city's extract_parameter, the value for buildConnectionString's city. Response fields: docs://geo/searchGeoCities.

tools.name: searchGeoISP
tools.description: Search the ISP catalog for mobile ISP targeting (mobile proxies only). Always resolve the code through this tool — never accept a real-world ASN number as a substitute. Returns each carrier's name and catalog code, the value for buildConnectionString's isp. Response fields: docs://geo/searchGeoISP.

tools.name: searchGeoRegions
tools.description: Search regions/states within a country, identified by its ISO country_code (from listGeoCountries). Returns each region's extract_parameter, the value for buildConnectionString's state, and its numeric code, used as searchGeoCities' region_code. Response fields: docs://geo/searchGeoRegions.

tools.name: searchGeoZips
tools.description: Search ZIP codes within a country, for use in proxy username params. Returns ZIP values to pass as buildConnectionString's zip; ZIP targeting cannot be combined with state or city. Response fields: docs://geo/searchGeoZips.

tools.name: setProxyIpWhitelist
tools.description: Replace the IP whitelist for a proxy resource, restricting authentication to the given IPs. This controls who can authenticate; to control which domains the proxy can reach, use setProxyTargetHosts. Returns the updated proxy with the applied IP whitelist. Response fields: docs://proxy-settings/setPr

tools.name: setProxyLimits
tools.description: Set the traffic or spending limit on a proxy resource to control costs. A proxy has one limit: this call replaces any existing limit, and total_limit 0 removes it. The counter resets daily or monthly according to time_period. Returns the updated proxy with the applied limits. To change other setting

tools.name: setProxyTargetHosts
tools.description: Replace the target host whitelist for a proxy resource, restricting its traffic to the given domains. This controls where the proxy can connect; to control who can authenticate, use setProxyIpWhitelist. Returns the updated proxy with the applied target host whitelist. Response fields: docs://proxy-s

tools.name: updateProxyResource
tools.description: Update description, countries, status, IP whitelist, or limits in one call. Name and proxy_type are not mutable through this MCP tool. For single-field changes, prefer setProxyIpWhitelist, setProxyLimits, or deactivateProxyResource. Returns the complete updated proxy without its password. Response f
